assertions.title: full consent/report/export/feedback/delete flow and removed routes
golden report JSON matches the released full pipeline fixture and independently planted peak
warm cache retains provenance and consent changes cannot reuse provider output
cursor pagination ignores arbitrary next URLs and uses fixed host and bearer header
Graph backoff handles 429 and stops after a bounded number of attempts
SSRF blocks private DNS, userinfo, deceptive suffixes, ports and redirects by response
image features use actual scores and do not invent OCR confidence
images abstain without consent and use OCR fallback only when consented
explanation verifier rejects missing keys, numeric mismatch and unsupported text
judge errors fail closed; empty explanations have no rate
authenticated token encryption binds owner and detects tampering
deletion drains jobs and removes record, feedback, tokens, cache and sessions
retention excludes expired records and Mongo TTL is declared
no posts abstains; missing message does not invent a value
one post has per-post sentiment, negation and a valid denominator
non-English text is unscored and unicode survives tokenization
emoji-only and empty input are distinct
readability uses raw words including stopwords and at least three sentences
taxonomy uses whole tokens and returns evidence
TF-IDF is normalized and uses document frequency
acquisition permission failures produce unavailable modules, never empty-observation conclusions
cache is isolated by owner, consent and prompt metadata
repeated cursor and identity mismatch stop ingestion
inferences reject absent ids, nonverbatim spans, empty evidence and sensitive attributes
empty inferences have no estimated rejection rate and model can abstain
inference does not call provider without consent or posts
only OAuth-owned matching email can query HIBP, no active account claim
pinned inference request uses strict native JSON schema and no application storage
HIBP sends attribution-compatible user-agent and requests full breach objects; 404 is empty
logger refuses free text and discards identifiers including numeric IDs
empty and one-post profiles abstain
circular mean handles midnight and cancels antipodes
explicit timezone handles daylight saving and midnight
entropy uses occupied-bin correction and n
intervals preserve zero gaps and sorted median
weekend ratio abstains for zero denominator and missing fields count correctly
provenance abstains without an invented confidence
images finish before synthesis; module failure is isolated
queue deduplicates jobs and draining prevents writes for deleted owners
cache clones results, expires and deletes by owner
offline server starts with no credentials or database and closes cleanly
live startup fails closed on missing configuration or insecure transport
set precision/recall counts duplicates once and handles empty denominators
CER and WER count substitutions, insertions and unicode code points
timing distributions state n and interpolation
likes map to documented categories with supporting ids
no likes abstains
